params.name: model_version
params.why: TabPFN-2.5 weights need a licence acceptance with a Prior Labs account; without TABPFN_TOKEN we use the ungated v2 weights (Nature 2025). Set the token and rerun to use 2.5.

params.name: context_rows
params.why: Stratified subsample of the training split. The full 32,950 rows are infeasible on CPU (see cost figure). Fallback #1 from the plan.

params.name: n_estimators
params.why: Ensemble of input permutations/preprocessings averaged by TabPFN. Reduced from the default 8 to halve CPU time.

params.name: categorical_features_indices
params.why: Integer-coded categoricals are flagged so TabPFN treats them as categories, not numbers.

params.name: tuning
params.why: The point of the model: zero hyperparameter tuning, compared against five tuned models.

params.name: random_state
params.why: Fixes the ensemble's permutations and the context subsample.
